request: Owner: «ты можешь начать добавлять какие-то анимации… с этими пейзажами заигрывать, с Веспи — это добавило бы визитную карточку всему сайту».
method: Higgsfield image-to-video from the shipped landscape stills (the 2k upscales of the Tuscan road and the Florence belvedere, jobs in landscapes-2026-11-03.json), 5 s, aspect auto, prompt asking for a locked-off camera and ambient motion only (cape and collar in the breeze, grass and cypress tops, haze, a few distant swallows, drifting clouds). Two models per scene were rendered and compared frame by frame; Kling 4.0 (1080p) kept the Tuscan dust light and Vespi unchanged, MiniMax H3 (2K) kept the belvedere sky to a few small birds where Kling painted a whole flock. In the Higgsfield sandbox (ffmpeg): the Tuscan frame cropped to its left 89.5% like the still (tiny figures at the right edge), forward + reversed concat (first reversed frame dropped) for a seamless 10 s ping-pong loop, scaled to 1280 and 640 px wide, H.264 high@4.0, CRF 25/27, yuv420p, faststart, no audio. The files were carried over as grayscale PNG parts and rebuilt byte-for-byte (sha256 below).

prompts.tuscany: Locked-off camera, subtle ambient motion only: the small cotton toy rider on the cream vintage scooter stays exactly in place; its cream cape stirs gently in a warm breeze; the golden grass and the cypress tops sway softly; warm dust motes drift in the low sun; the distant haze shimmers. No camera movement, no new objects, no people, no text, photoreal, calm, seamless loop.
prompts.belvedere: Locked-off camera, subtle ambient motion only: the small cotton toy on the stone parapet stays exactly in place, one paw shading its eyes; its cream cape and felt collar stir in a light breeze; a few distant swallows cross the sky; thin clouds drift slowly over the rooftops and the dome; the river glints; a gentle heat shimmer over the city. No camera movement, no people, no new objects, no text, photoreal, calm, seamless loop.
prompts.bologna: Locked-off camera, subtle ambient motion only: the small cotton toy walker in the arcade stays exactly in place, mid-step, same pose; its tiny canvas backpack straps and olive felt collar stir in a light breeze; warm evening light flickers softly through the arches; faint dust motes drift in the sunbeams; the hanging lanterns sway very slightly. No camera movement, no new objects, no people, no text, photoreal, calm, seamless loop.

placement: src/components/motion/LivingLandscape.tsx: the video lies over the still with the still's own layout class, is loaded only when the tile is in view (narrow file at ≤640px), fades in on the first played frame, pauses off-screen, and is skipped entirely under prefers-reduced-motion or Save-Data. The still stays the poster and the only image for screenshots and reviews. On the home page the same component lies over the Bologna still in the welcome scene (src/components/home/Hero.tsx).
